I had logged into the VM earlier but was unable to view the assignments… as per the README.md I tried making a new directory se2001 but again no BPT was visible… pls clarify

posts.name: Ishan Shishodiya
posts.cooked:
It appears that your se2001 directory has been deleted. Try doing the following -

mkdir se2001
cd se2001
mkdir BPT1_problem_{1..4}
cd BPT1_problem_1
synchro show

You should be able to view BPT1_problem_1 with this.
